design_context: Premium Editorial Brand Showcase for NIVORAM

headings.usage: Large editorial headings. E1 Principle: Rotate font genres, DO NOT use Inter/DM Sans for headings.
headings.styling: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for H1/H2, generous line height.

body.usage: Body text, nav links, labels, buttons.
body.styling: Clean, highly readable. Use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-widest) for overlines and small labels.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft shadows only. NO heavy drop shadows. Prefer subtle ambient shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px soft warm border (#E5DCD0) for dividers, outlines, and grids. NO excessive rounded cards. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: NO glassmorphism overload. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text if overlapping imagery.
visual_enhancers.photography_treatment: Spotlight lighting, intentionally clipped frames. Surround images in #FFFFFF space.

effects.hero: Signature on-load masked line-by-line heading reveal using Framer Motion (initial Y offset + opacity into place).
effects.hover: Gentle image zoom (scale 1.03 to 1.05) on hover with overflow-hidden containers.
effects.scroll: Staggered card grids via Framer Motion whileInView, subtle parallax on desktop.
effects.nav: Animated underlines (width: 0% to 100%) on nav item hover.
effects.marquee: One slow editorial marquee with Cormorant Garamond, charcoal or terracotta text on warm cream bg.

layouts.spacing: Generous whitespace. Use py-20, py-32 for structural spacing. gap-8 to gap-16 for grids.
layouts.structure: Asymmetrical, 'Tetris' grid or Swiss editorial style. Avoid generic center-everything disease.
layouts.product_cards: White surface (#FFFFFF), charcoal text (#302B32), minimal/zero border radius. Image nested with padding.

image_urls.description: Ornate silver horn with intricate woven design
Geometric shapes in black, brown, and tan arranged on a light surface
A brown leather box with a gold clasp on white
Spacious modern living room with elegant sofas and stylish decor.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: The project files are in .js/jsx, NOT .tsx. Configure files accordingly.
Set up Tailwind CSS configuration to include the custom colors (warm-cream, charcoal, terracotta, royal-purple, soft-border, whatsapp-green).
Integrate lenis for smooth scrolling in the main application wrapper.
Implement the Hero section with a masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion.
Build the slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee or standard CSS keyframes.
Ensure data-testid is added to all actionable and key UI elements.
